abstract: A common VAR approach is to identify responses to TFP news shocks by maximizing the variance share of TFP over a long horizon. We find that these TFP max share estimators tend to be biased in large samples when applied to data generated from DSGE models with shock processes that match TFP moments in the data, especially in the presence of TFP measurement error. We propose an alternative max share news estimator that reduces this bias and the RMSE of the impulse response estimates, even when there is sizable measurement error in the news variable. When applying this estimator to U.S. data, we find that news shocks are slower to diffuse to TFP and have a smaller effect on real activity than implied by the TFP max share estimator.
abstract_zh: 常见的VAR方法是通过最大化全要素生产率（TFP）在长期内的方差份额来识别对TFP新闻冲击的响应。我们发现，当将这种TFP最大份额估计量应用于由DSGE模型生成的数据时（该模型的冲击过程与数据中的TFP矩相匹配），尤其是在存在TFP测量误差的情况下，这些估计量在大样本中往往存在偏误。我们提出了一种替代性的最大份额新闻估计量，该估计量能够减少这种偏误以及脉冲响应估计的均方根误差（RMSE），即使新闻变量存在显著的测量误差。当将此估计量应用于美国数据时，我们发现新闻冲击对TFP的扩散速度比TFP最大份额估计量所隐含的更慢，且对实际经济活动的影响更小。
title: Estimating Macroeconomic News and Surprise Shocks
title_zh: 估算宏观经济新闻与意外冲击

abstract: • A representative sample of Italian consumers participated in a Choice Experiment. • Green-Score is more effective than organic at increasing WTP for sustainable food. • The effectiveness of labels varies widely across different food product categories. • Salience nudges increase consumer preference for the Green-Score label. • PDO certification remains the most influential for culturally significant products. The Green-Score label aims to complement established certifications by providing a standardized and easily interpretable assessment of products’ environmental performance. This study examines (i) the relative influence of Green-Score, organic, and Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) certifications on consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP); (ii) how label effectiveness varies across food categories; and (iii) the impact of a salience nudge on consumer choices. A Discrete Choice Experiment was conducted with a nationally representative sample of 1,102 Italian consumers, using a between-subjects design to evaluate the nudge. Results show that PDO labels, leveraging strong institutional credibility and symbolic value, consistently generate the highest marginal WTP (€7.61), especially for culturally and traditionally significant products. Green-Score A+ labels, valued for their diagnosticity and cross-product comparability, achieve an average marginal WTP of €6.25, slightly above organic certification (€4.59), with variation across product categories and treatment conditions. The salience nudge enhances the perceived value of Green-Score, particularly in contexts where environmental performance is salient, and can reduce the marginal contribution of overlapping labels such as organic certification. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of sustainability labels depends on both the balance between credibility and diagnosticity and the product-specific context, offering actionable insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to design targeted and effective environmental labelling strategies in food markets.
abstract_zh: • 一项以意大利消费者代表性样本为对象的选择实验。 • 在提升可持续食品支付意愿方面，Green-Score比有机认证更有效。 • 标签的有效性在不同食品产品类别间差异显著。 • 显著性助推增加了消费者对Green-Score标签的偏好。 • 对于具有文化意义的产品，PDO认证仍最具影响力。Green-Score标签旨在通过提供标准化且易于理解的产品环境绩效评估，补充现有认证体系。本研究考察了：(i) Green-Score、有机认证和原产地保护认证（PDO）对消费者支付意愿（WTP）的相对影响；(ii) 标签有效性在不同食品类别间的差异；以及(iii) 显著性助推对消费者选择的影响。研究采用离散选择实验，以1,102名意大利消费者的全国代表性样本为对象，并通过受试者间设计评估助推效果。结果表明，PDO标签凭借强大的制度公信力和象征价值，持续产生最高的边际支付意愿（€7.61），尤其对具有文化和传统意义的产品效果显著。Green-Score A+标签因其诊断性和跨产品可比性而受到重视，平均边际支付意愿为€6.25，略高于有机认证（€4.59），且在不同产品类别和处理条件下存在差异。显著性助推增强了Green-Score的感知价值，尤其在环境绩效显著的情境中，并可能降低有机认证等重叠标签的边际贡献。这些发现表明，可持续标签的有效性既取决于公信力与诊断性之间的平衡，也取决于产品特定情境，为政策制定者和利益相关者设计食品市场中针对性且有效的环境标签策略提供了可操作的见解。
title: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
title_zh: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他成熟标签的比较分析

abstract: Abstract I show that home ownership decisions across countries and individuals are shaped by a cultural heritage from agriculture. For centuries, dominant assets in preindustrial economies were either land or cattle. Consequently, the type of farming prevailing locally shaped preferences and beliefs about the relative value of immovable and movable assets. This cultural heritage had long-lasting consequences. Today, individuals originating from societies with a history of crop agriculture—where the dominant asset was land—are more likely to be homeowners. For identification, I rely both on home ownership decisions of second-generation immigrants in the United States and on an instrument.
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Household Finance at the Origin: Home Ownership as a Cultural Heritage from Agriculture

abstract: Common‐pool resources—such as collectively‐owned grasslands—are often overused and depleted until effective conservation strategies are put into place. We conducted a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment to examine the performance of different management strategies on the sustainability of common‐pool grassland management in China. We designed three experimental interventions—reward, punishment, and communication—to evaluate how to cost‐effectively promote grassland conservation. Results reveal that the communication treatment is as effective as the reward and punishment treatments in promoting grassland conservation. However, unlike the reward treatment, communication does not require external funding or create income inequality among herders, and unlike the punishment treatment, it avoids undesirable impacts such as reducing herders' net payoffs. A mechanism analysis suggests that our communication treatment shifts herders' focus from exploitation to conservation. Our results indicate that incorporating communication interventions into grassland management strategies could improve their overall performance.
abstract_zh: 公共池资源——例如集体所有的草原——往往因过度使用而枯竭，直至有效的保护策略得以实施。我们开展了一项实地实验室实验，考察不同管理策略对中国公共池草原管理可持续性的影响。我们设计了三种实验干预措施——奖励、惩罚和沟通——以评估如何以成本有效的方式促进草原保护。结果表明，沟通干预在促进草原保护方面与奖励和惩罚干预同样有效。然而，与奖励干预不同，沟通干预无需外部资金支持，也不会在牧民之间造成收入不平等；与惩罚干预不同，它避免了降低牧民净收益等不良影响。机制分析表明，我们的沟通干预将牧民的关注点从开发利用转向保护。研究结果表明，将沟通干预纳入草原管理策略可提升其整体绩效。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Performance of reward, punishment, and communication in common‐pool resource management: Evidence from grassland conservation in China
title_zh: 奖励、惩罚与沟通在公共池塘资源管理中的绩效：来自中国草原保护的证据

abstract: The prospect for electric vehicles (EVs) as a climate change solution hinges on their widespread adoption across political lines. This study uses county-level data to show that from 2012 to 2023 about half of all new EV registrations in the United States went to the 10% most Democratic counties, and about one-third went to the top 5%. This correlation is largely stable over time and remains after controlling for household income, gasoline prices, and other observables. EV trucks are a small share of the EV market but show a lower correlation than other EV types. We also conducted a survey, finding little difference in the ability of Democrats and Republicans to answer questions about EVs.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）作为气候变化解决方案的前景，取决于其在各政治派别中的广泛普及。本研究利用县级数据表明，从2012年至2023年，美国新增电动汽车注册量中约有一半流向了最倾向民主党的10%县，约三分之一流向了前5%的县。这一相关性在时间上基本保持稳定，并且在控制家庭收入、汽油价格及其他可观测因素后依然存在。电动卡车在电动汽车市场中所占份额较小，但其相关性低于其他类型的电动汽车。我们还进行了一项调查，发现民主党人和共和党人在回答有关电动汽车问题上的能力几乎没有差异。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Political Ideology and U.S. Electric Vehicle Adoption
title_zh: 政治意识形态与美国电动汽车普及

abstract: In a $k$ -replica Edgeworth box economy, we compare outcomes of laboratory markets in which human traders have different visualizations available on their screens. Novel visualizations include a heat map that shows at a glance the value of all feasible portfolios (i.e., final allocations); a geometric display of the order book; and order entry via point-and-click on the heat map. Efficiency metrics focus on allocations, prices and profitability. Compared to the traditional text-oriented trader screen for the continuous double auction, we find that the novel features generally increase all three efficiency metrics.
abstract_zh: 在一个$k$重复埃奇沃思盒经济中，我们比较了人类交易者在屏幕上拥有不同可视化选项的实验室市场结果。新颖的可视化功能包括：热力图，可一目了然地显示所有可行投资组合（即最终配置）的价值；订单簿的几何展示；以及通过点击热力图进行订单输入。效率指标侧重于配置、价格和盈利能力。与传统的面向文本的连续双向拍卖交易屏幕相比，我们发现新颖功能通常能提升所有三项效率指标。
title: Market visualizations

abstract: What explains wealth and portfolio differences between black and white Americans? We find that disparities in economic factors explain portfolios well, but only partly explain the wealth gap. In a dynamic setting, economic factors often change optimal saving rates in ways that offset their effects on income and returns. Consequently, their net wealth effect is often limited, making the wealth gap harder to explain. We estimate that differences in income levels, income risk, family structures, mortality, health expenditures, property taxes, mortgage rates, and asset returns explain half of the differential between the racial wealth gap and the racial income gap.
abstract_zh: 什么因素导致了美国黑人与白人之间的财富和投资组合差异？我们发现，经济因素的差异能够较好地解释投资组合差异，但只能部分解释财富差距。在动态环境中，经济因素常常会改变最优储蓄率，从而抵消其对收入和回报的影响。因此，这些因素的净财富效应往往有限，使得财富差距更难以解释。我们估算，收入水平、收入风险、家庭结构、死亡率、医疗支出、房产税、抵押贷款利率以及资产回报率的差异，解释了种族财富差距与种族收入差距之间差异的一半。
title: A Dynamic Model of the Racial Wealth Gap
title_zh: 种族财富差距的动态模型

abstract: This paper examines the effects of differences in sectoral compositions between countries on the liberalization of global tariffs in the coalition-proof Nash equilibrium sense. Using a static tariff-setting game with endogenous trade agreements, I develop a competing exporters model with three countries that differ in their sectoral compositions. I consider two settings that are differentiated by the type of trade agreements that countries can sign: free trade agreements (FTAs) and multilateral trade agreements, i.e., no FTAs. I study both symmetric and asymmetric differences in sectoral compositions across countries and find that, contrary to earlier results based on economic size asymmetries, FTAs act as stumbling blocks to the multilateral trading system when countries sufficiently differ in their sectoral compositions. This result is caused by the existence of a free riding incentive. Lastly, I show that permitting internal tariffs in FTAs typically strengthens the free riding incentive under symmetric sectoral differences, and in the asymmetric case may either mitigate or exacerbate the stumbling-block problem depending on countries’ sectoral compositions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了国家间部门构成差异对全球关税自由化的影响，在联盟证明纳什均衡的意义上进行分析。通过一个具有内生贸易协定的静态关税设定博弈，我构建了一个包含三个部门构成不同的国家的竞争性出口商模型。我考虑了两种设置，其区别在于国家可以签署的贸易协定类型：自由贸易协定（FTAs）和多边贸易协定，即无自由贸易协定的情况。我研究了国家间部门构成的对称和不对称差异，并发现，与先前基于经济规模不对称的结果相反，当国家在部门构成上存在显著差异时，自由贸易协定成为多边贸易体系的绊脚石。这一结果源于搭便车激励的存在。最后，我表明，在对称部门差异下，允许自由贸易协定中的内部关税通常会增强搭便车激励，而在不对称情况下，则可能根据国家的部门构成减轻或加剧绊脚石问题。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: How do sectoral compositions affect the impact of FTAs on global tariff liberalization?
title_zh: 部门构成如何影响自由贸易协定对全球关税自由化的作用？

abstract: This paper examines a Bertrand duopoly with homogeneous products and one-sided cost uncertainty. We characterize the undominated equilibria which yield the unique equilibrium payoffs. This uniqueness result could be applied to many important market situations. In particular, we apply our results to examine cost-reducing R&D by an entrant firm that enters a monopolistic market. While significant cost-reducing investments can result in a low marginal cost of production, we show that it may be optimal for the entrant to induce some technological uncertainty by restraining its investment level within certain limits as a means to ease any potential intense competition resulting from such investments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个同质产品且存在单边成本不确定性的伯特兰双寡头市场。我们刻画了无支配均衡，这些均衡产生了唯一的均衡收益。这一唯一性结果可应用于许多重要的市场情境。特别地，我们将结果应用于考察进入垄断市场的企业进行降低成本研发的情形。尽管显著的降本投资可能导致较低的生产边际成本，但我们表明，进入者可能最优地通过将投资水平限制在一定范围内来引发某种技术不确定性，以此缓解此类投资可能带来的激烈竞争。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Bertrand competition with one-sided cost uncertainty
title_zh: 单边成本不确定下的伯特兰竞争

abstract: Partisan vitriol has become a defining feature of American politics, evident in survey responses and social media discourse. Conventional wisdom holds that these expressions reflect deeply rooted hostility. Yet they may also function as social signals, reinforcing loyalty and conformity within partisan groups. In this view, animosity is less about entrenched ideological divisions and more about fostering cohesion among co-partisans. We test this proposition in two settings. First, using the 2012 American National Election Studies, which recorded interviewer partisanship, we exploit within-interviewer variation to examine whether respondents adjusted their reported hostility depending on the partisan identity of their interviewer. Respondents expressed significantly more animosity when interviewed by a co-partisan and less when facing an opposing-partisan interviewer. Second, in an online experiment with 1,510 participants, we find that revealing a partner’s partisan alignment—when it matched the participant’s—encouraged more frequent out-group attacks and in-group promotion. These behaviours were strongly shaped by social norms: participants were substantially more likely to attack when their partner had done so in the previous round. Together, these findings suggest that partisan hostility is contingent on immediate social context, not solely on deeply held animus.
abstract_zh: 党派恶语相向已成为美国政治的一个显著特征，在调查反馈和社交媒体讨论中随处可见。传统观点认为，这些言论反映了根深蒂固的敌意。然而，它们也可能发挥社会信号的作用，强化党派内部的忠诚与从众心理。按照这种观点，敌意更多源于促进同党成员间的凝聚力，而非固化的意识形态分歧。我们在两个场景中检验了这一命题。首先，利用记录了访谈者党派归属的2012年美国全国选举研究数据，我们通过分析同一访谈者面对不同受访者时的差异，考察受访者是否会根据访谈者的党派身份调整其表达的敌意程度。结果显示，当受访者面对同党访谈者时，其表达的敌意显著增强；而面对对立党派访谈者时，敌意则明显减弱。其次，在一项包含1510名参与者的在线实验中，我们发现：当参与者得知搭档的党派立场与自己一致时，他们会更频繁地攻击外群体并推崇内群体。这些行为深受社会规范的影响——若搭档在前一轮中发起攻击，参与者发动攻击的可能性会显著提高。综合来看，这些发现表明，党派敌意取决于即时的社会情境，而非仅仅源于根深蒂固的敌视情绪。
title: Animosity is for the Audience: How Social Context Shapes Expressions of Political Hostility
title_zh: 敌意是给观众看的：社会情境如何塑造政治敌意的表达
